# zhpev

> Computes all eigenvalues and, optionally, eigenvectors of a complex Hermitian matrix in packed storage.

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```js
import zhpev from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/zhpev';
```

### Layout API

Takes a storage layout (`order`) and leading dimensions, like CBLAS/LAPACKE.

```js
zhpev( order, jobz, uplo, N, AP, w, strideW, Z, LDZ, WORK, RWORK ) → info: integer
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `order` | `Layout` | Storage layout ('row-major' or 'column-major') |
| `jobz` | `"no-vectors" \| "compute-vectors"` | `'none'` (eigenvalues only) or `'compute'` (eigenvalues + eigenvectors)<br>One of `'no-vectors'`, `'compute-vectors'`. |
| `uplo` | `MatrixTriangle` | `'upper'` or `'lower'` |
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Order of the matrix A<br>Requires `N ≥ 0` |
| `AP` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>length trunc(N * (N + 1) / 2)</sub> | **in/out** · Packed Hermitian matrix (length N\*(N+1)/2) |
| `w` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>length N</sub> | **out** · Output array for eigenvalues (length N) |
| ↳ `strideW` | `integer` | Stride length for `w` |
| `Z` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>N × N</sub> | **out** · Output eigenvector matrix (N x N) |
| ↳ `LDZ` | `PositiveInteger` | Leading dimension of Z<br>Rejects `ldz < 1 \|\| (jobz === 'compute-vectors' && ldz < N)` |
| `WORK` | `Complex128Array \| null`<br><sub>length ≥ max(1, 2 * N - 1)</sub> | **out** · Complex workspace array (length >= max(1, 2\*N-1)) |
| `RWORK` | `Float64Array \| null`<br><sub>length ≥ max(1, 3 * N - 2)</sub> | **out** · Real workspace array (length >= max(1, 3\*N-2)) |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `jobz`:

  -   `= 'N'`: Compute eigenvalues only;
  -   `= 'V'`: Compute eigenvalues and eigenvectors.
- `uplo`:

  -   `= 'U'`: Upper triangle of A is stored;
  -   `= 'L'`: Lower triangle of A is stored.
- `N`: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.
- `AP`: On entry, the upper or lower triangle of the Hermitian matrix A, packed columnwise in a linear array. The j-th column of A is stored in the array `AP` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*j/2) = A(i,j)` for $1 \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*(2*n-j)/2) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le n$.

  On exit, `AP` is overwritten by values generated during the reduction to tridiagonal form. If `UPLO = 'U'`, the diagonal and first superdiagonal of the tridiagonal matrix T overwrite the corresponding elements of A, and if `UPLO = 'L'`, the diagonal and first subdiagonal of T overwrite the corresponding elements of A.
- `w`: If `INFO = 0`, the eigenvalues in ascending order.
- `Z`: If `JOBZ = 'V'`, then if `INFO = 0`, Z contains the orthonormal eigenvectors of the matrix A, with the i-th column of Z holding the eigenvector associated with `W(i)`. If `JOBZ = 'N'`, then Z is not referenced.

</details>

**Returns** `info: integer`: 0 if successful

**Throws**

- `TypeError` first argument must be a valid order
- `TypeError` second argument must be one of the following: "no-vectors", "compute-vectors"
- `TypeError` third argument must be a valid matrix triangle
- `RangeError` fourth argument must be a nonnegative integer
- `RangeError` ninth argument is invalid (rejected when `LDZ < 1 \|\| ( jobz === "compute-vectors" && LDZ < N )`)

### Strided (ndarray) API

Takes explicit strides and offsets for every array. Use it for views, sub-matrices and non-unit strides.

```js
zhpev.ndarray(
    jobz, uplo,
    N,
    AP, strideAP, offsetAP,
    w, strideW, offsetW,
    Z, strideZ1, strideZ2, offsetZ,
    WORK, strideWork, offsetWork,
    RWORK, strideRWork, offsetRWork
) → info: integer
```

Computes all eigenvalues and optionally eigenvectors of a complex Hermitian matrix in packed storage.

Matrix shapes are logical (rows × columns). The reference's leading dimension (`LDA`, …) is replaced by the two strides and the offset.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `jobz` | `"no-vectors" \| "compute-vectors"` | `'no-vectors'` (eigenvalues only) or `'compute-vectors'` (eigenvalues + eigenvectors) |
| `uplo` | `MatrixTriangle` | `'upper'` or `'lower'` |
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Order of the matrix A<br>Requires `N ≥ 0` |
| `AP` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>length trunc(N * (N + 1) / 2)</sub> | **in/out** · Packed Hermitian matrix; on exit, overwritten by zhptrd |
| ↳ `strideAP` | `integer` | Stride length for `AP` (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `offsetAP` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for `AP` (in complex elements) |
| `w` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>length N</sub> | **out** · Output array for eigenvalues (length N), in ascending order |
| ↳ `strideW` | `integer` | Stride for `w` |
| ↳ `offsetW` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for `w` |
| `Z` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>N × N</sub> | **out** · Output eigenvector matrix (N x N); referenced only if jobz = `'compute-vectors'` |
| ↳ `strideZ1` | `integer` | Stride of the first dimension of `Z` (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `strideZ2` | `integer` | Stride of the second dimension of `Z` (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `offsetZ` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for `Z` (in complex elements) |
| `WORK` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>length ≥ max(1, 2 * N - 1)</sub> | **out** · Workspace array (length >= max(1, 2\*N-1), complex elements) |
| ↳ `strideWork` | `integer` | Stride for `WORK` (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `offsetWork` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for `WORK` (in complex elements) |
| `RWORK` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>length ≥ max(1, 3 * N - 2)</sub> | **out** · Workspace array (length >= max(1, 3\*N-2)) |
| ↳ `strideRWork` | `integer` | Stride for `RWORK` |
| ↳ `offsetRWork` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for `RWORK` |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `jobz`:

  -   `= 'N'`: Compute eigenvalues only;
  -   `= 'V'`: Compute eigenvalues and eigenvectors.
- `uplo`:

  -   `= 'U'`: Upper triangle of A is stored;
  -   `= 'L'`: Lower triangle of A is stored.
- `N`: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.
- `AP`: On entry, the upper or lower triangle of the Hermitian matrix A, packed columnwise in a linear array. The j-th column of A is stored in the array `AP` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*j/2) = A(i,j)` for $1 \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*(2*n-j)/2) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le n$.

  On exit, `AP` is overwritten by values generated during the reduction to tridiagonal form. If `UPLO = 'U'`, the diagonal and first superdiagonal of the tridiagonal matrix T overwrite the corresponding elements of A, and if `UPLO = 'L'`, the diagonal and first subdiagonal of T overwrite the corresponding elements of A.
- `w`: If `INFO = 0`, the eigenvalues in ascending order.
- `Z`: If `JOBZ = 'V'`, then if `INFO = 0`, Z contains the orthonormal eigenvectors of the matrix A, with the i-th column of Z holding the eigenvector associated with `W(i)`. If `JOBZ = 'N'`, then Z is not referenced.

</details>

**Returns** `info: integer`: 0 if successful, >0 if zsteqr/dsterf did not converge

**Throws**

- `TypeError` first argument must be one of the following: "no-vectors", "compute-vectors"
- `TypeError` second argument must be a valid matrix triangle
- `RangeError` third argument must be a nonnegative integer

### Status codes

An `info` status code: `0` on success. A positive value reports a numerical condition such as a singular pivot or a failure to converge (see the description). Invalid arguments throw instead of returning a negative `info`. Returns immediately when `N === 0` or `N === 1`.

The reference documents `INFO` as:

-   `= 0`: successful exit.
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.
-   `> 0`: if `INFO = i`, the algorithm failed to converge; i off-diagonal elements of an intermediate tridiagonal form did not converge to zero.

</section>

<section class="notes">

## Notes

-   `zhpev()` corresponds to the reference LAPACK routine [`ZHPEV`](https://github.com/Reference-LAPACK/lapack/blob/v3.12.0/SRC/zhpev.f).

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

```js
import Complex128Array from '@stdlib/array/complex128/lib/index.js';
import Float64Array from '@stdlib/array/float64/lib/index.js';
import zhpev from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/zhpev';

// 3x3 Hermitian matrix [[5,1-i,2+i],[1+i,4,1],[2-i,1,6]] in lower packed storage:
const AP = new Complex128Array( [ 5, 0, 1, 1, 2, -1, 4, 0, 1, 0, 6, 0 ] );
const w = new Float64Array( 3 );
const Z = new Complex128Array( 9 );
const WORK = new Complex128Array( 10 );
const RWORK = new Float64Array( 10 );

zhpev.ndarray( 'compute-vectors', 'lower', 3, AP, 1, 0, w, 1, 0, Z, 1, 3, 0, WORK, 1, 0, RWORK, 1, 0 ); // eslint-disable-line max-len

console.log( 'eigenvalues:', w ); // eslint-disable-line no-console
```

</section>
